title: Trie search with wildcards (DFS over children)
summary: A '.' matches any letter, so at that position try every existing child recursively. Normal letters follow one child.

sections.title: Idea
sections.body: ✍️ Walk the word as in a normal search. At a '.', the next node could be **any** existing child — recurse into each and return true if any succeeds.

sections.title: Template
Word Search II (recognition)
sections.body: Insert all words into a trie; DFS from every grid cell walking the trie at the same time; stop as soon as the current path is not a prefix. Remove found words (or mark them) to avoid duplicates. Much faster than running Word Search once per word.

sections.title: Complexity
sections.body: Without dots O(L); each dot can branch 26 ways, so worst case O(26^dots · L).
